users.create.title: Create user
users.create.description: Create a user: a tenant principal creates one in its own tenant; a platform principal may name the home tenant or create a platform account.
users.get.title: Get user
users.get.description: Get a user by ID; tenant principals only see their own tenant.
users.list.title: List users
users.list.description: List users with paging, filters, keyword and sorting; tenant principals only see their own tenant.
users.update.title: Update user
users.update.description: Update a user's display name, email and phone number.
users.delete.title: Delete users
users.delete.description: Delete users in batch (soft delete) and revoke their sessions; you cannot delete yourself.
users.lock.title: Lock users
users.lock.description: Lock users in batch and revoke their sessions; you cannot lock yourself.
users.unlock.title: Unlock users
users.reset_password.title: Reset user password
users.reset_password.description: Set a new password for a user, revoke their sessions and require a change at next login.
auth.login.title: Sign in
auth.login.description: Sign in with user name and password (tenant optional; platform accounts leave it empty; when the captcha is on, include the id and code from auth.captcha). Returns a second-step ticket when the account has two-factor on, otherwise access and refresh tokens.
auth.refresh.title: Refresh tokens
auth.refresh.description: Exchange a refresh token for new tokens; the refresh token rotates and the old one stops working.
auth.logout.title: Sign out
auth.logout.description: Revoke the session of the current token.
auth.me.title: Get current user
auth.me.description: Return the current user, tenant, session and roles.
profile.change_password.title: Change password
profile.change_password.description: Change your own password; requires the current password and revokes your other sessions.
user_settings.get.title: Get user setting
user_settings.get.description: Read one of your own settings by scene and key; the value is empty until saved.
user_settings.update.title: Save user setting
user_settings.update.description: Write one of your own settings by scene and key, replacing it whole or creating it; an empty value clears it.
identity.user.name_taken: User name '{userName}' is already taken in tenant '{tenant}'.
identity.user.tenant_mismatch: The home tenant '{requested}' differs from the current tenant '{current}'.
identity.user.self_operation: You cannot perform this operation on your own account.
identity.user.display_name_blank: The display name must not be blank.
identity.user.email_invalid: The email address is not well-formed.
identity.auth.invalid_credentials: The user name or password is incorrect.
identity.auth.locked_out: Too many failed sign-in attempts; try again in {seconds} seconds.
identity.auth.session_invalid: The session has expired or been revoked; sign in again.
identity.auth.no_session: The current token carries no session and cannot be signed out.
identity.password.too_short: The password must be at least {min} characters long.
identity.password.too_simple: The password must contain both letters and digits.
identity.password.reused: The password must differ from the last {depth} passwords.
identity.auth.tenant_unavailable: Tenant '{tenantId}' does not exist or is suspended.
auth.switch_tenant.title: Switch tenant
auth.switch_tenant.description: Switch the current session to another tenant (home tenant or a tenant the user is a member of) or back to the platform (platform accounts only); returns new tokens.
impersonation.start.title: Start impersonation
impersonation.start.description: Sign in as another user: opens a separate session for the target and returns tokens carrying the actor claim. Tenant subjects stay in their own tenant.
impersonation.stop.title: Stop impersonation
impersonation.stop.description: End impersonation: revokes the impersonation session and returns tokens for the actor's original session.
impersonation.candidates.title: List impersonation candidates
impersonation.candidates.description: List up to 20 active users that can be impersonated in a tenant (or the platform), matched by keyword.
identity.impersonation.active: The current session is already impersonating another user.
identity.impersonation.not_active: The current session is not impersonating anyone.
auth.verify_two_factor.title: Complete two-factor sign-in
auth.verify_two_factor.description: Second step of two-factor sign-in: submit the code with the ticket from auth.login; returns access and refresh tokens on success.
auth.captcha.title: Get captcha
auth.captcha.description: Issue a captcha (4 digits, valid for one use within 5 minutes).
auth.login_config.title: Get sign-in settings
auth.login_config.description: Sign-in page settings: available sign-in methods, third-party providers and whether a captcha is required.
profile.get.title: My profile
profile.get.description: Your profile and account security summary (two-factor, last password change).
profile.setup_totp.title: Start authenticator setup
profile.setup_totp.description: Start binding an authenticator: generate a new key (confirm with an authenticator code within 10 minutes). Not available while impersonating.
profile.enable_two_factor.title: Enable two-factor
profile.enable_two_factor.description: Turn on a two-factor method: confirm the authenticator with a code from the newly generated key. Not available while impersonating.
profile.disable_two_factor.title: Disable two-factor
profile.disable_two_factor.description: Turn off a two-factor method: confirm with a current authenticator code. Not available while impersonating.
users.reset_two_factor.title: Reset user two-factor
users.reset_two_factor.description: Reset two-factor for users in bulk (clears all methods and authenticator keys); you cannot reset yourself.
identity.auth.captcha_invalid: The captcha is wrong or has expired. Please try again.
identity.auth.login_throttled: Too many sign-in attempts. Please try again in {retryAfter} seconds.
identity.two_factor.ticket_invalid: Two-step verification has expired. Please sign in again.
identity.two_factor.code_invalid: The verification code is invalid or has expired.
identity.two_factor.unavailable: Two-factor is on for this account but no method is usable. Ask an administrator to reset it.
identity.two_factor.totp_already_enabled: An authenticator is already bound; turn it off first to switch devices.
identity.two_factor.totp_setup_missing: The authenticator binding has expired or was not started. Generate a new key.
identity.field_security.protected: Field {field} is protected by field security and cannot be used to filter or sort.
identity.field_security.read_only: Field {field} is read-only for you and cannot be filled in or changed.
auth.activate_roles.title: Switch active roles
auth.activate_roles.description: Change the roles the current session has activated (all held right now and not violating dynamic separation of duty); returns new tokens.
sessions.list.title: List online users
sessions.list.description: Page through the online users of the current tenant: one row per active session with device, browser, masked IP, sign-in location, sign-in and last activity time and realtime presence; narrowed by data scope.
sessions.summary.title: Get online summary
sessions.summary.description: Online overview of the current tenant: active sessions, users with an active session and users connected in real time.
sessions.revoke.title: Force sign-out
sessions.revoke.description: Force sign-out: revoke active sessions of the current tenant; the clients are notified in real time and sign out. Your own current session cannot be revoked here.
identity.session.not_found: Session {id} does not exist or is no longer active.
identity.session.current: You cannot force your own current session to sign out; sign out instead.
auth.lock.title: Lock session
auth.lock.description: Lock the current session (screen lock) with a one-off lock password; afterwards every request of this session except unlock and logout is rejected with IDENTITY_DENIED_002.
auth.unlock.title: Unlock session
auth.unlock.description: Unlock the current session with its lock password; five wrong attempts in a row revoke the session (a forced sign-out). Works while locked.
identity.auth.session_locked: This session is locked; unlock it first.
identity.auth.lock_password_required: The lock password must not be empty.
identity.auth.unlock_exhausted: Too many failed unlock attempts; the session has ended. Please sign in again.
identity.auth.lock_reason_unsupported: The session is locked for a reason that a lock password cannot clear.
my_api_credentials.list.title: My open API credentials
my_api_credentials.list.description: List your own open API credentials (secrets are never shown).
my_api_credentials.create.title: Create open API credential
my_api_credentials.create.description: Create an open API credential (at most 5 per person); the secret is returned this once only. Not available in impersonation sessions.
my_api_credentials.update.title: Enable or disable open API credential
my_api_credentials.update.description: Enable or disable one of your open API credentials. Not available in impersonation sessions.
my_api_credentials.rotate_secret.title: Rotate credential secret
my_api_credentials.rotate_secret.descrip: Rotate the secret of one of your credentials: the old secret stops working at once and the new one is returned this once only. Not available in impersonation sessions.
my_api_credentials.delete.title: Delete open API credentials
my_api_credentials.delete.description: Delete your open API credentials; their AppKeys stop working at once. Not available in impersonation sessions.
my_api_credentials.settings.title: My call security settings
my_api_credentials.settings.description: Your call security settings: the signature algorithm and IP allow-list, applied to all your credentials.
my_api_credentials.update_settings.title: Save call security settings
my_api_credentials.update_settings.descr: Save your call security settings (replaced as a whole and applied to all your credentials at once). Not available in impersonation sessions.
identity.api_credentials.limit_reached: You can have at most {max} API credentials; delete ones you no longer use and try again.
identity.api_credentials.not_found: The credential does not exist or is not yours.
identity.api_credentials.ip_too_many: The IP allow-list can have at most {max} entries.
auth.external_login.title: Third-party sign-in
auth.external_login.description: Third-party sign-in: exchanges the one-time ticket from the callback for the account bound in the chosen home tenant; unbound identities are rejected (sign in with a password and bind it in your profile first). Account status, lockout and two-factor apply as for password sign-in.
profile.external_logins.title: My third-party accounts
profile.external_logins.description: List the third-party accounts bound to you.
profile.link_external.title: Confirm third-party binding
profile.link_external.description: Confirm a binding: binds the third-party account from the one-time ticket to the signed-in user; only the user who started the binding can confirm it, and it is refused when someone else has bound the account. Not available in impersonation sessions.
profile.unlink_external.title: Unbind third-party account
profile.unlink_external.description: Unbind one of your third-party accounts. Not available in impersonation sessions.
identity.external.ticket_invalid: The third-party sign-in has expired; please start again.
identity.external.not_bound: This third-party account is not bound yet. Sign in with your password first, then bind it in your profile.
identity.external.taken: This third-party account is already bound to another user.
identity.external.not_found: No binding for this third-party provider.
profile.begin_external_bind.title: Start third-party binding
profile.begin_external_bind.description: Start a binding: issues a binding intent for the signed-in user (10 minutes, single use) and returns the URL to the third-party authorization; only that user can confirm the resulting ticket. Not available in impersonation sessions.
identity.external.provider_not_found: This third-party sign-in method does not exist or is not enabled.
profile.sessions.title: My signed-in devices
profile.sessions.description: List your signed-in devices: all your active sessions (platform and tenants alike), the current one first.
profile.revoke_session.title: Sign out device
profile.revoke_session.description: Sign out one of your devices; use sign-out for the current one.
profile.revoke_other_sessions.title: Sign out other devices
profile.revoke_other_sessions.descriptio: Sign out all your devices except the current one, including impersonation sessions you started that are still open.
profile.notification_preference.title: My notification preferences
profile.notification_preference.descript: Your notification preferences: in-app, email and SMS channels and announcement, task and security topics; everything is received until saved. Mandatory and emergency notifications ignore them.
profile.update_notification_preference.d: Save your notification preferences (replaces them as a whole).
profile.update.title: Save profile
profile.update.description: Save your profile: display name, real name, gender, birthday, country or region and bio (replaced as a whole; blanks count as empty).
profile.change_username.title: Change username
profile.change_username.description: Change your username: requires your current password, once every 90 days, unique within your home tenant. Not available in impersonation sessions.
profile.remove_avatar.title: Remove avatar
profile.remove_avatar.description: Remove your avatar; the avatar file is reclaimed. Upload a new one with POST /api/profile/avatar.
identity.avatar.invalid: The avatar must be a JPEG or PNG image of at most {max} MB.
identity.user_name.unchanged: The new username is the same as the current one.
identity.user_name.too_soon: The username can be changed once every 90 days; try again in {days} days.

openapi.tags.auth.name: Authentication
openapi.tags.auth.description: Sign-in and sign-out, token refresh, two-factor, third-party sign-in, switching tenant and active roles, screen lock, and the current user's information and permissions.
openapi.tags.profile.name: Profile
openapi.tags.profile.description: Your own profile, password and username, two-factor, third-party accounts, signed-in devices and notification preferences.
openapi.tags.user_settings.name: User settings
openapi.tags.user_settings.description: Your own settings stored by scene and key, used by the front end to sync preferences across devices.
openapi.tags.impersonation.name: Impersonation
openapi.tags.impersonation.description: Sign in as another user, end impersonation and list the users that can be impersonated.
openapi.tags.sessions.name: Online users
openapi.tags.sessions.description: Query, summarize and force sign-out of the active sessions in the current tenant.
openapi.tags.my_api_credentials.name: Open API credentials
openapi.tags.my_api_credentials.descript: Create, enable or disable, rotate and delete your own open API credentials, and manage call security settings.
openapi.groups.identity.name: Identity and accounts
openapi.groups.identity.description: Users and authentication, online users, impersonation and the personal profile.
